[EN] I haven't had customers for awhile...and now I have to evacuate? This is just too depressing.
[ES] Hace tiempo que no tengo clientes... ¿y ahora tengo que evacuar? Esto es demasiado deprimente.

[EN] Sigh...I guess I'll be safe, at least.
[ES] Suspiro... Supongo que al menos estaré a salvo.
